title: ACAT Panel Configuration
description: UI layout configuration for scanners, keyboards, menus, and dialogs in ACAT. Defines widget hierarchies, color schemes, and animation (scanning) sequences.

widgetAttributes.description: List of widget attribute definitions that customize labels, values, and fonts for named widgets

colorScheme.description: Default color scheme for the layout (must match a scheme defined in the active theme)

animations.description: Animation sequences defining the scanning order and behavior for this panel

widgetAttribute.description: Attributes for a widget (label, value, font settings)

name.description: Name of the widget this attribute applies to

value.description: Value or command associated with the widget

fontSize.description: Font size in points or a DTD entity reference

contextEnabled.description: Whether the widget is enabled based on context (e.g., text selected)

widget.description: A UI widget in the panel hierarchy

name.description: Unique name for this widget within the panel

type.description: Widget type name (maps to a C# UserControl or widget class)

subtype.description: Optional widget subtype for further specialization

value.description: Command or value associated with this widget

children.description: Child widgets nested within this widget

animation.description: A named scanning sequence for the panel

name.description: Unique name for this animation sequence within the panel

isFirst.description: If true, this is the first animation sequence activated when the panel opens. Exactly one sequence should have isFirst=true.

autoStart.description: If true, scanning starts automatically when this sequence begins

iterations.description: Number of times to scan through the widget list before the sequence ends. Use '0' for infinite repeat or a preference variable reference.

scanTime.description: Time in milliseconds each widget stays highlighted. Supports literal values or preference variable references.

onEnter.description: PCode script executed when this animation sequence begins

onEnd.description: PCode script executed when all iterations of this sequence complete

widgets.description: Ordered list of widget names to highlight in this animation sequence

animationWidget.description: A single widget step in an animation sequence

name.description: Name of the widget to highlight. Supports wildcard ('Box1/*') and variable ('@SelectedWidget') forms.

playBeep.description: If true, a beep sound plays when this widget is highlighted

onSelected.description: PCode script executed when the user selects this widget
